name: io.github.gowinder/urlchart
title: UrlChart
description: Render charts as PNG images from a URL — Google Image Charts / Image-Charts compatible API.

tools.name: generate_chart_image
tools.description: Render a PNG chart through UrlChart and return the image plus its hosted URL. Accepts Google Image Charts / legacy parameters as an object (`{"cht":"bvg","chs":"400x200","chd":"t:10,40,80"}`) or a full legacy chart URL (Google, Image-Charts, QuickChart or urlchart.com). Without an api_key (or an Authorization: Bearer header on this MCP connection) the render is the FREE tier: a canvas of at most 1000 px per side / 1 MP, 60 requests/minute and 1,000 unique renders/month per IP. A request above that canvas is scaled down and reported in X-UrlChart-Meta, never failed. A paid api_key keeps the full 9 MP canvas (3000 px per side) and applies the paid limits. Parameters that are unknown or not implemented never fail the render; they degrade and are reported in X-UrlChart-Meta. chof=jpg|webp|pdf requests another output format; a PDF result is returned as a hosted URL (not an image block). The hosted URL in the text result is the same chart without any credential, so embedding it publicly serves the FREE (capped-canvas) variant unless a key or signed URL is added.

params.description: Legacy chart parameters. Either an object of parameter name -> value (cht, chs, chd, chds, chl, chdl, chdlp, chxt, chxl, chxr, chxs, chxp, chxtc, chco, chtt, chts, chma, chg, chf, chbh, chls, chm (and chld/choe for cht=qr)), or a full chart URL / query string. Values may be strings or numbers.

api_key.description: Optional UrlChart API key (uc_live_… / uc_test_…). Omit to use the free tier. Alternatively send `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on the MCP request itself.

tools.name: check_legacy_chart_url
tools.description: The migration check: analyse a Google Image Charts / Image-Charts / QuickChart URL and report, parameter by parameter, what UrlChart will render, degrade, ignore or not support — plus the equivalent UrlChart URL. Computed from the URL alone: NOTHING is rendered and no request is made to the chart host. Use this before migrating an embed to find out what changes (for example a multi-axis URL that an alternative charts it only on a paid plan).

url.description: The full legacy chart URL, including https://.

tools.name: build_chart_url
tools.description: Build a well-formed UrlChart chart URL from a small, LLM-friendly chart spec. No render, no network, no key. Returns the URL as text; pass it to generate_chart_image (or embed it) to get the PNG. For chart types or parameters outside this spec, use generate_chart_image with raw legacy parameters.

values.description: Data. For bar/line/pie/doughnut: one series (number[]) or several series (number[][]). For scatter: number[][] where the FIRST row is the x series and each further row a y series.

labels.description: Category labels (chl): one per value for a single series. Omit for no labels. For scatter, labels are not used.

colors.description: Series colours as hex (with or without #) or legacy colour names (chco).

background.description: Background colour (chf=bg,s,…), hex or legacy name.
